# DatatalkwithAnkit

> LLM inference benchmarks, GPU comparisons and prices, and AI market analysis by Ankit Dongare, an AI engineer who benchmarks LLM serving. Benchmarks are published with their configs.

## Guides
- [Best GPU for LLM inference (2026)](https://www.datatalkwithankit.com/gpu-guide): how many H100, H200, B200, B300, MI300X, MI325X or MI355X GPUs a model needs, specs, and lowest on-demand prices. Updated quarterly.

## Posts
- [H200 vs MI300X: what you're actually paying for](https://www.datatalkwithankit.com/posts/h200-vs-mi300x): memory, NVLink vs PCIe scaling, and neocloud pricing.

## Tools
- [Will-it-fit calculator](https://www.datatalkwithankit.com/#fit-section): GPUs needed and hourly cost for a model size and precision.

## About
- [Home](https://www.datatalkwithankit.com/): who Ankit is and what he works on.
- [Uses](https://www.datatalkwithankit.com/uses): tools used for benchmarking.
